name: Ayaka
source:
Ayaka is the mysterious woman from rebel organization Atheista.

[spoiler]Her real name is Ayaka Fehde Falcon. She is Atheista's supervisor and current Leader of Sect Falcon. She wants to take a revenge on Queen and Queencroiz because of her parents death despite the fact that Sect Falcon started the war 7 years ago.[/spoiler]
